report_title: # P0043 ARC12 Separator-Arrow-Guided Panel-Stamp Development-40 Packet
claim_boundary: P0043 is a source-pinned, failure-inclusive same-cohort development measurement against the already exposed P0042 mixed-partition roster (20 ARC-AGI-1 evaluation-split tasks plus 20 ARC-AGI-2 training-split tasks). P0042 was the immutable pre-change baseline; its exposed failure taxonomy motivated one bounded generic relation, and the relation was implemented, unit-tested, committed, and pushed at feff068b8e1e1116427f87f59af4e54b922a1dd1 before this packet was created or executed. This is not fresh transfer evidence, is non-comparable to all-training transfer, and cannot support a benchmark-submission claim. The frozen relation requires a unique modal background; exactly one non-background full-width divider; exactly three distinct upper colors that form left-to-right 3x3 template, up/down-arrow, and payload roles; one lower template-color occupancy mask exactly matching the upper template; and a wholly background 3x3 destination immediately above or below the lower template. Colors, positions, masks, backgrounds, separator colors, and arrow direction are re-derived per input; task IDs, cohort metadata, GT data, GT solvers, historical decompositions, and held-out test outputs are excluded from the live controller. The controller commits a complete grid before post-answer all-cell V&V. Every NO remains in the denominator. This P0043 result cannot retune the frozen source; promotion requires a separately frozen, globally disjoint mixed-partition transfer roster before its task grids are read.

development_baseline_reference.comparison_boundary: P0042 is the immutable exposed baseline on the identical internal development roster. P0043 may report a same-cohort delta only; it must not be called transfer or a benchmark score.

prior_protocol_reference.comparison_boundary: P0041 is immutable final all-training transfer evidence on a distinct protocol and cohort. P0043 neither revises P0041 nor supplies a numerical transfer delta.

operator_provenance.architecture_role: A strict perception-to-compatibility bridge: current-grid role binding first identifies a lower template by occupancy-mask agreement, resolves a unique up/down control glyph, then applies the remaining upper payload only when the implied lower destination is fully background.
fixed_or_forbidden_shortcuts: No task ID, task-specific lookup, source filename, cohort record, or benchmark label is passed to the live controller.
No fixed ARC color, background color, separator color, grid size, coordinate, payload mask, or arrow direction is encoded.
No GT feature contract, GT solver, historical decomposition, or held-out test output is imported, parsed, or called by the live controller.
No ambiguous arrow, multiple divider, tied modal background, template mismatch, overlapping role order, blocked destination, or out-of-bounds stamp is accepted.
required_observable_structure: One unique non-background full-width horizontal divider.
Three non-overlapping upper 3x3 color-role masks ordered template, arrow, payload.
One lower foreground color whose global 3x3 occupancy mask equals the upper template mask.
One exact up or down arrow occupancy mask and a wholly background implied destination.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: P0043 measures a frozen generic vocabulary without importing, parsing, calling, or passing through GT feature records or GT solver code. P0042 was intentionally exposed as development evidence; its outputs informed the pre-freeze relation design, but are not available to the P0043 live controller before its answers are committed.

synthetic_contract.coverage: The frozen contract derives dynamic backgrounds, separator colors, template/payload colors, role vertical positions, lower anchor positions, payload masks, and both arrow directions from visible demonstrations; it rejects duplicate arrows, mismatched templates, blocked destinations, multiple dividers, and contradictory visible outputs.

visual_contract.coverage: The frozen renderer keeps ARC black and magenta distinct, preserves compact labels for structural operators, and explicitly labels this relation as an arrow-guided panel stamp; each measured task emits a native SVG corpus-callosum trace.
